Usage: agentcage init [OPTIONS] [NAME]

  Scaffold a new agentcage config file.

Options:
  -o, --output TEXT               Output file path.  [default: cage.yaml]
  --image TEXT                    Container image.  [default: node:22-slim]
  --isolation [container|vm|apple-container]
                                  Isolation backend (default: auto-detect from
                                  platform — container on Linux, apple-container
                                  on macOS 26+ ASi when Apple `container` is
                                  installed, vm otherwise).
  --force                         Overwrite existing file.
  --scaffold TEXT                 Use a scaffold template (e.g. openclaw).
  --list-scaffolds                List available scaffolds and exit.
  --port INTEGER                  Host port to publish (scaffold-specific).
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
